shorts.hook: For two hundred years, people said a bird leads badgers to honey.
shorts.title: Nobody Has Proved the Bird That Leads Badgers to Honey
shorts.outro: Doug's other four deaths are in the full video below.
shorts.description: A 2023 Journal of Zoology study asked whether honey badgers and honeyguide birds really cooperate. The old story is famous, but nobody has proved it. Doug's cartoon deaths are fiction; the science is real and sourced in the full video.

shorts.hook: A male lion walked away from a meal he had already won.
shorts.title: Why a Male Lion Walked Away From His Own Meal
shorts.outro: The six-lion charge is in the full video below.
shorts.description: A male lion walked away from a meal he had already won, and a 9 kg honey badger is part of the reason. Doug watches from a safe cartoon distance. The science is real and sourced in the full video.

shorts.title: One Honey Badger Ran Straight at Six Lions
shorts.outro: Then Doug tried to follow it. Full video below.
shorts.description: One honey badger ran straight at six lions on a road in South Africa (Kapama ranger blog, 2012). Doug tried to follow it. Cartoon deaths only; sources are in the full video.
